info.name: Nex Developer AI Lists Graph API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of entity nodes to return

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Use `html` to receive an interactive graph visualization instead of JSON.

items.docs: Returns the full knowledge graph for the workspace, including CRM entity nodes, relationship edges, context edges (from ingested text), insight triplet edges (AI-extracted subject-predicate-object relationships), insight nodes, and insight link edges (semantic relationships between insights). Supports an optional `limit` query parameter to control the maximum number of entity nodes returned (default 1000, max 5000). Set `Accept: text/html` or `?format=html` to receive an interactive visualizatio
